kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نجتذب (form VIII)
# نَجْتَذِبُ (najtaḏibu) /nad͡ʒ.ta.ði.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# نُجْتَذَبُ (nujtaḏabu) /nud͡ʒ.ta.ða.bu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# نَجْتَذِبَ (najtaḏiba) /nad͡ʒ.ta.ði.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# نُجْتَذَبَ (nujtaḏaba) /nud͡ʒ.ta.
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
